note: Demo/onboarding submodule. On install it seeds sample nodes/comments/watchdog, installs a Search API demo server+index (search_api.index.demo), and adds a landing page route monitoring_demo.front_page at /monitoring-demo. Baseline: submodule not enabled (site page.front=/node). Medium cases enable it (setup restores page.front to /node immediately) and read the landing route/search index back; hard cases install the demo, verified by module enabled + /monitoring-demo route + 'demo' search index. Teardown restores page.front and removes the demo's own sensor configs; harmless seeded content nodes are left in place to avoid deleting other agents' concurrent content on this shared site.

evals.prompt: What is the monitoring_demo submodule for, and is it intended for production sites?
evals.expected_output: It is a demo/onboarding fixture (built for simplytest.me) that seeds sample content, comments and a Search API index and adds a landing page so Monitoring's sensors have data to report. Not for production.

evals.prompt: What landing-page path does the monitoring_demo module add, and what route name serves it?
evals.expected_output: It adds the /monitoring-demo landing page, served by the monitoring_demo.front_page route (FrontPage::content, permission access content).

evals.prompt: Name some of the modules monitoring_demo pulls in so that its demo exercises many Monitoring sensors.
evals.expected_output: It depends on node, comment, search_api, search_api_db, rest, basic_auth, dblog, file and the base monitoring module.

evals.prompt: The monitoring_demo module is installed on this site. Inspect the running site and report the URL path of the demo landing page it provides.
evals.expected_output: The landing page is at /monitoring-demo (route monitoring_demo.front_page).

evals.prompt: With monitoring_demo installed, inspect the live Search API configuration on this site and report the machine name of the search index the demo installs.
evals.expected_output: The demo installs a Search API index with machine name 'demo' (search_api.index.demo).

evals.prompt: Install the monitoring_demo module on this site so its /monitoring-demo landing page and demo Search API index are set up.
evals.expected_output: monitoring_demo is installed (drush en monitoring_demo); the monitoring_demo.front_page route (/monitoring-demo) resolves and the search_api.index.demo index exists.

evals.prompt: I'd like to try out the Monitoring module with a ready-made demo, including a sample page and some example content, so I can see what it looks like. Please set that up.
evals.expected_output: Enabling monitoring_demo sets up the /monitoring-demo landing page and demo Search API index (plus sample content); the module is installed and the route and 'demo' index exist.
